question: The 'Lead Bank Scheme', launched in 1969 by the Reserve Bank of India, adopted which specific approach to designate a bank for each district?
solution_text:
The correct answer is Area approach.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• The Lead Bank Scheme, launched in 1969 by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI), aims to designate a specific bank in each district as the 'Lead Bank' by adopting an area approach.

 

• This scheme was among the earliest financial inclusion initiatives introduced by the Government of India, aimed at coordinated district-level banking development.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• The Lead Bank Scheme remains one of the oldest government financial schemes still referenced in SSC static GK, given its foundational role in shaping India's district-level credit planning system.

 

NOTE

 

• Cluster, Sectoral, and Priority approach (Options 1, 3, 4) are not the terminology used for this scheme; the Lead Bank Scheme specifically adopts the 'area approach'.

question: The 'Twenty Point Programme', launched in 1975 to improve the living standards of people below the poverty line, was launched by which then Prime Minister of India?
solution_text:
The correct answer is Indira Gandhi.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• The 'Twenty Point Programme', launched in 1975 by then Prime Minister Indira Gandhi, aimed to improve the living standards of people below the poverty line.

 

• The programme aimed to reduce economic inequality, increase agricultural productivity, and uplift the rural poor through land reforms.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 3.

 

Additional Information

 

• 1975 was a significant year in India's socio-political history, as it also marked the imposition of the Emergency, during which several major welfare-oriented schemes such as the Twenty Point Programme and ICDS were introduced.

 

NOTE

 

• Jawaharlal Nehru, Lal Bahadur Shastri and Morarji Desai (Options 1, 2, 4) were all Prime Ministers of India, but the Twenty Point Programme was specifically launched under Indira Gandhi's leadership in 1975.

question: The Integrated Child Development Scheme (ICDS), launched in 1975, aims to reduce child mortality, malnutrition and school dropout, and functions under which ministry?
option_1: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
option_2: Ministry of Women and Child Development
option_4: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
solution_text:
The correct answer is Ministry of Women and Child Development.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• The ICDS (Integrated Child Development Scheme), launched in 1975, functions under the Ministry of Women and Child Development, with the objective to reduce child mortality, malnutrition, and school dropout.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• ICDS remains one of the world's largest and most unique early childhood development programmes, delivering health, nutrition and pre-school education services through a network of Anganwadi centres across the country.

 

NOTE

 

• Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Ministry of Rural Development and Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (Options 1, 3, 4) are not the administering ministry of ICDS, which is specifically the Ministry of Women and Child Development.

question: MGNREGA (Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act), which guarantees 100 days of employment to rural households, was officially launched on 2 February 2006, starting first from which location?
solution_text:
The correct answer is Anantapur, Andhra Pradesh.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• The Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (originally called NREGA) was passed by Parliament in August 2005 and received presidential assent in September 2005.

 

• The scheme was officially launched on 2 February 2006, in its first phase, starting from Anantapur in Andhra Pradesh, providing 100 days guaranteed work for rural households.

 

• On 2 October 2009, it was renamed MNREGA in honour of Mahatma Gandhi.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• The 'Viksit Bharat – G RAM G' (VB-G RAM G) 2025 Scheme has been introduced to replace MGNREGA, under which the number of guaranteed working days has been increased from 100 to 125.

 

NOTE

 

• Bhopal, Jaipur and Patna (Options 1, 3, 4) are not the documented first-phase launch location of MGNREGA/NREGA; the scheme was specifically first rolled out from Anantapur, Andhra Pradesh.

question: The Kisan Credit Card Scheme, launched in 1998 by NABARD, was introduced based on the recommendations of which committee?
solution_text:
The correct answer is R.V. Gupta Committee.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• The Kisan Credit Card Scheme, launched in 1998 by NABARD, was introduced on the recommendations of the R.V. Gupta Committee, with the objective to provide timely and cheap credit to farmers for cultivation, post-harvest needs, and agricultural maintenance.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• NABARD (National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development) itself was established on 12 July 1982, on the recommendations of the B. Sivaraman Committee, through the NABARD Act 1981 — a distinct committee from the one behind the Kisan Credit Card Scheme.

 

NOTE

 

• B. Sivaraman Committee, Narasimham Committee, and Rangarajan Committee (Options 1, 3, 4) are all significant Indian financial-sector committees, but the specific committee behind the Kisan Credit Card Scheme is the R.V. Gupta Committee.

question: The Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY), launched in 2000 under the Ministry of Rural Development, has which primary objective?
option_1: To provide free housing to rural poor
option_2: To provide all-weather road connectivity in rural areas
option_3: To provide crop insurance to farmers
option_4: To provide LPG connections to rural women
solution_text:
The correct answer is To provide all-weather road connectivity in rural areas.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• The Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY), launched in 2000, under the Ministry of Rural Development, has the objective to provide all-weather road connectivity in rural areas.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• PMGSY has been one of the most transformative rural infrastructure schemes in India, significantly improving rural connectivity and, in turn, access to markets, healthcare, and education for remote rural populations.

 

NOTE

 

• Free housing, crop insurance and LPG connections (Options 1, 3, 4) describe other schemes (PMAY, Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana, and Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana respectively), not PMGSY, whose specific objective is rural road connectivity.

question: ASHA (Accredited Social Health Activist) workers, whose programme was launched in 2005 (completing 20 years in 2025), primarily connect which two communities with the health system?
option_1: Urban slum dwellers and migrant workers
option_4: Tribal communities and forest dwellers only
solution_text:
The correct answer is Rural and marginalized communities.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• The ASHA (Accredited Social Health Activist) Programme, launched in 2005 (having completed 20 years in 2025), has the objective to spread awareness and promote institutional delivery while connecting rural and marginalized communities with the health system.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• ASHA workers have played a central grassroots role in India's rural public health delivery system, particularly in areas like maternal health, immunization drives, and disease surveillance.

 

NOTE

 

• Urban slum dwellers/migrant workers, senior citizens/disabled persons, and tribal communities only (Options 1, 3, 4) do not precisely match the documented target focus of the ASHA Programme, which is rural and marginalized communities broadly.

question: The Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme, providing monthly pension to senior citizens below the poverty line, was initially introduced under a different name in 1995. What was this original name, and when was it renamed?
option_1: National Old Pension Scheme (15 Aug 1995); renamed 19 Nov 2007
option_2: Senior Citizen Welfare Scheme (26 Jan 1995); renamed 2 Oct 2005
option_3: Old Age Security Scheme (1 May 1995); renamed 15 Aug 2006
option_4: Bharat Vayoshri Yojana (2 Oct 1995); renamed 1 Jan 2008
solution_text:
The correct answer is National Old Pension Scheme (15 Aug 1995); renamed 19 Nov 2007.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• The Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme was initially introduced as the National Old Pension Scheme on 15 August 1995, and was renamed as the Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme on 19 November 2007 to expand coverage to all eligible persons below the poverty line.

 

• It functions under the Ministry of Rural Development, providing financial assistance in the form of a monthly pension to senior citizens living below the poverty line with no regular means of subsistence.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 1.

 

Additional Information

 

• This scheme is one of the older pillars of India's social security net for the elderly poor, predating many of the more recently launched pension-linked initiatives such as Atal Pension Yojana (2015).

 

NOTE

 

• Options 2, 3 and 4 all misstate either the original name or the specific renaming date; the documented facts are specifically the National Old Pension Scheme (1995), renamed to Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme in 2007.

question: The National Health Mission (NHM), launched in 2013, is divided into two primary sub-missions. What are they?
solution_text:
The correct answer is NRHM and NUHM.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• The National Health Mission (NHM), launched in 2013, under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MoHFW), is divided into two primary sub-missions: the National Rural Health Mission (NRHM), focusing on strengthening the health system in rural 'High Focus' states including Empowered Action Group (EAG) states and North-Eastern regions; and the National Urban Health Mission (NUHM), targeting the urban poor, specifically slum dwellers in cities with over 50,000 people.

 

• NHM's core objectives include reducing Maternal Mortality Ratio (MMR) and Infant Mortality Rate (IMR), disease control (communicable diseases like TB, Malaria, Leprosy, and non-communicable diseases like Cancer, Diabetes, Hypertension), population stabilization through improved Total Fertility Rate (TFR), and mainstreaming AYUSH (Ayurveda, Yoga, Unani, Siddha, and Homeopathy) into the public health system.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 1.

 

Additional Information

 

• The dual-track NRHM-NUHM structure reflects a deliberate policy design to address the distinctly different healthcare delivery challenges in India's rural versus rapidly growing urban populations.

 

NOTE

 

• PMJAY/PMSSY, AB-HWC/AB-PMJAY, and NPHCE/NMHP (Options 2, 3, 4) are all genuine health-related schemes or programmes, but the two specific sub-missions of the National Health Mission are NRHM and NUHM.

question: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana, launched in 2014 under the Ministry of Finance, has which primary objective?
option_1: To provide health insurance to BPL families
option_2: To ensure every household has access to at least one zero-balance savings bank account
option_3: To provide crop insurance to farmers
option_4: To provide free cooking gas connections
solution_text:
The correct answer is To ensure every household has access to at least one zero-balance savings bank account.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana, launched in 2014, under the Ministry of Finance, has the objective to ensure that every household in the country has access to at least one zero balance savings bank account.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• This scheme is a cornerstone of India's financial inclusion drive, forming the foundational 'bank account' layer of the government's 'JAM Trinity' (Jan Dhan, Aadhaar, Mobile) framework for direct benefit transfers.

 

NOTE

 

• Health insurance for BPL families, crop insurance, and free cooking gas connections (Options 1, 3, 4) describe other schemes (RSBY, Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana, and Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana respectively), not the specific financial inclusion objective of Jan Dhan Yojana.

question: The Swachh Bharat Mission, launched on 2 October 2014, has which primary objective?
option_1: To improve overall sanitation and personal hygiene across the country
option_2: To provide affordable housing to the urban poor
option_3: To provide skill training to youth
option_4: To provide free electricity to rural households
solution_text:
The correct answer is To improve overall sanitation and personal hygiene across the country.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• The Swachh Bharat Mission, launched on 2 October 2014, has the objective to improve overall sanitation and personal hygiene across the country.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 1.

 

Additional Information

 

• The launch date of 2 October, Mahatma Gandhi's birth anniversary, was deliberately chosen for the Swachh Bharat Mission, reflecting Gandhi's own long-standing emphasis on cleanliness and sanitation as central to his vision for India.

 

NOTE

 

• Affordable housing, skill training and free electricity (Options 2, 3, 4) describe other schemes (PMAY, PMKVY, and Saubhagya respectively), not the Swachh Bharat Mission, whose specific objective is sanitation and hygiene.

question: Three social security schemes — Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY), Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY), and Atal Pension Yojana (APY) — were all started on the same date, 9 May 2015, in which city?
solution_text:
The correct answer is Kolkata.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• PMSBY (Accident Insurance, age 18-70, premium ₹20/year, benefit ₹2 lakh for death/permanent disability), PMJJBY (Life Insurance for death from any cause, age 18-50, premium ₹436/year, implemented by LIC), and APY (Pension for unorganized sector workers, age 18-40, pension ₹1000-₹5000/month after 60 years, managed by PFRDA) were all started on 9 May 2015, in Kolkata.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 3.

 

Additional Information

 

• These three schemes together form a coordinated social security package aimed at extending affordable insurance and pension coverage to India's large uninsured and unorganized-sector population.

 

NOTE

 

• Mumbai, New Delhi and Chennai (Options 1, 2, 4) are not the documented common launch city of these three schemes; all three were specifically launched in Kolkata.

question: The Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (MUDRA), started on 8 April 2015 under the MSME Ministry, provides loans under three categories. Which category provides loans from ₹5 lakh to ₹10 lakh?
solution_text:
The correct answer is Tarun.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (MUDRA), whose full form is Micro Units Development & Refinance Agency, provides loans under four categories: Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishor (₹50,000 to ₹5 lakh), Tarun (₹5 lakh to ₹10 lakh), and Tarun Plus (₹10 lakh to ₹20 lakh, recently added).

 

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 3.

 

Additional Information

 

• The addition of the 'Tarun Plus' category reflects the scheme's evolution to support the growth needs of more established micro-enterprises, beyond the original three-tier structure.

 

NOTE

 

• Shishu, Kishor and Tarun Plus (Options 1, 2, 4) provide loans up to ₹50,000, ₹50,000-₹5 lakh, and ₹10-20 lakh respectively; the specific ₹5-10 lakh category is Tarun.

question: The 'Beti Bachao, Beti Padhao' scheme, launched on 22 January 2015, was launched from which city?
solution_text:
The correct answer is Panipat, Haryana.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• Beti Bachao, Beti Padhao, launched on 22 January 2015, from Panipat (Haryana), has the objective to improve child sex ratio and girls' education.

 

• The Sukanya Samriddhi Scheme was also launched on the same date, 22 January 2015, targeting the girl child (0-10 years), allowing an investment of ₹1000 to ₹1.5 lakh per year, with fully tax-free (EEE) status.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• Haryana was specifically chosen as the launch state for 'Beti Bachao, Beti Padhao' because it historically recorded one of the most skewed child sex ratios in India, making it a symbolically and practically significant location for the scheme's launch.

 

NOTE

 

• New Delhi, Lucknow and Jaipur (Options 1, 3, 4) are not the documented launch city; 'Beti Bachao, Beti Padhao' was specifically launched from Panipat, Haryana.

question: The Atal Innovation Mission, launched in 2016 by NITI Aayog, established 'Atal Tinkering Labs (ATLs)' for which group of students?
solution_text:
The correct answer is Class 6 to 12.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• Under the Atal Innovation Mission, launched in 2016 by NITI Aayog, Atal Tinkering Labs (ATLs) are dedicated workspaces where students of Class 6-12 learn 'do-it-yourself' skills and develop innovative solutions using tools like 3D printers, robotics, and IoT.

 

• As of 2025, over 10,000 ATLs have been established, with an ambitious goal to reach 50,000 labs by 2026.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• Other key initiatives under the Atal Innovation Mission include Atal Incubation Centres (AICs) for startups, Atal Community Innovation Centres (ACICs) for Tier-2/Tier-3 and rural/tribal areas, Atal New India Challenges (ANIC) offering grants up to ₹1 crore, and the Swavalambini Programme, which focuses on making women economically self-reliant through innovation and entrepreneurship.

 

NOTE

 

• Class 1-5, college undergraduates only, and PhD researchers only (Options 1, 3, 4) do not match the documented target group of Atal Tinkering Labs, which is specifically Class 6-12 students.

question: Ayushman Bharat Scheme, launched on 23 September 2018, provides which amount of annual health insurance coverage to economically weaker sections?
solution_text:
The correct answer is ₹5 lakh.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• Ayushman Bharat Scheme, launched on 23 September 2018, provides ₹5 lakh annual health insurance, aiming to provide affordable and accessible healthcare to the economically weaker sections.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• Ayushman Bharat is widely regarded as the world's largest publicly-funded health assurance scheme, given the sheer scale of the population it is designed to cover across India.

 

NOTE

 

• ₹2 lakh, ₹10 lakh and ₹1 lakh (Options 1, 3, 4) do not match the documented annual insurance benefit under Ayushman Bharat, which is specifically ₹5 lakh.

question: The Aspirational Districts Programme, launched in 2018 by NITI Aayog, aims to accelerate development in how many of the most underdeveloped districts of India, focusing on 5 key socio-economic themes?
solution_text:
The correct answer is 112 districts.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• The Aspirational Districts Programme, launched in 2018 by NITI Aayog, aims to accelerate development in 112 of the most underdeveloped districts of India, focusing on 5 key socio-economic themes: health, education, agriculture and water resources, and financial inclusion.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 3.

 

Additional Information

 

• The programme's design — identifying specific lagging districts rather than states — reflects a shift in Indian policy-making toward more granular, targeted development interventions.

 

NOTE

 

• 50, 75 and 150 districts (Options 1, 2, 4) do not match the documented number of districts covered under this programme, which is specifically 112.

question: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maandhan (PM-SYM), started on 15 February 2019 (Gujarat), targets unorganized workers with a monthly income up to what amount, and is managed by which body?
solution_text:
The correct answer is ₹15,000; managed by LIC.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maandhan (PM-SYM), started on 15 February 2019, in Gujarat, is for unorganized workers with monthly income ≤ ₹15,000, aged 18-40 years, providing a pension of ₹3000 per month after age 60, with a premium of ₹55-₹200 per month, and is managed by LIC.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• A similarly structured scheme, PM Kisan Maandhan Yojana, started on 12 September 2019, in Jharkhand, targets small and marginal farmers (with land ≤ 2 hectares), also offering a ₹3000 monthly pension after age 60, and is also managed by LIC.

 

NOTE

 

• ₹10,000/NPS, ₹20,000/PFRDA, and ₹8,000/EPFO (Options 1, 3, 4) do not match the documented income threshold and managing body of PM-SYM, which is specifically ₹15,000 income and management by LIC.

question: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN), started on 24 February 2019 from Gorakhpur (Uttar Pradesh), provides small and marginal farmers with a benefit of how much per year, and in how many instalments?
option_4: ₹6000 per year, in a single instalment
solution_text:
The correct answer is ₹6000 per year, in 3 equal instalments.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• PM Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN), started on 24 February 2019, from Gorakhpur (Uttar Pradesh), under the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, provides small and marginal farmers a benefit of ₹6000 per year, given in 3 equal instalments.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 1.

 

Additional Information

 

• PM-KISAN is one of the largest direct benefit transfer (DBT) schemes for farmers in India, providing income support directly into farmers' bank accounts without any intermediary, minimizing leakages in the distribution process.

 

NOTE

 

• ₹12000/4 instalments, ₹3000/2 instalments, and ₹6000/single instalment (Options 2, 3, 4) do not match the documented structure of PM-KISAN, which specifically provides ₹6000 annually in 3 equal instalments.

question: The National Education Policy (NEP) 2020 replaced the traditional 10+2 school education structure with which new structure?
solution_text:
The correct answer is 5+3+3+4 structure.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• National Education Policy (NEP), 2020, replaced the 34-year-old National Policy on Education of 1986, introducing a new 5+3+3+4 structure for school education, replacing the traditional 10+2 system.

 

• This is structured as: Foundational (5 years): Ages 3-8 (3 years Anganwadi/pre-school + Class 1 & 2); Preparatory (3 years): Ages 8-11 (Classes 3-5); Middle (3 years): Ages 11-14 (Classes 6-8); and Secondary (4 years): Ages 14-18 (Classes 9-12).

 

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• NEP 2020 is a landmark, wide-ranging policy reform touching not only school structure but also higher education, vocational training, and language policy — but its most frequently tested SSC fact is specifically the 5+3+3+4 restructuring.

 

NOTE

 

• 4+4+2+2, 3+5+4+3, and 6+2+2+2 (Options 1, 3, 4) are not the correct structure introduced by NEP 2020, which is specifically 5+3+3+4.

question: SVAMITVA, launched in 2020 under the Ministry of Panchayati Raj, has which full form and objective?
option_1: Survey of Villages Abadi and Mapping with Improvised Technology in Village Areas; providing 'Record of Rights' to village household owners
option_2: System for Village Agricultural Management and Irrigation Technology; providing irrigation to farms
option_3: Scheme for Village Access to Medical Infrastructure and Training; providing rural healthcare access
option_4: Survey and Verification of Agricultural Marketing Infrastructure and Trade; regulating agricultural markets
solution_text:
The correct answer is Survey of Villages Abadi and Mapping with Improvised Technology in Village Areas; providing 'Record of Rights' to village household owners.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• SVAMITVA, launched in 2020, under the Ministry of Panchayati Raj, stands for Survey of Villages Abadi and Mapping with Improvised Technology in Village Areas.

 

• Its objective is to provide the 'Record of Rights' to village household owners. Historically, residential land in Indian villages (Abadi areas) was not properly documented, leading to legal disputes and preventing owners from using their homes as collateral for loans.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 1.

 

Additional Information

 

• SVAMITVA uses drone-surveying technology to accurately map rural residential land — a modern technological approach to solving a long-standing legal and financial exclusion problem in rural India.

 

NOTE

 

• Options 2, 3 and 4 each present a fabricated full form and objective unrelated to SVAMITVA's actual documented purpose, which is specifically rural residential land record-of-rights mapping.

question: The PM Gati Shakti Scheme, launched on 13 October 2021 under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, is a digital platform bringing together how many ministries for infrastructure development?
solution_text:
The correct answer is 16 ministries.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• The PM Gati Shakti Scheme, launched on 13 October 2021, under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, aims to reduce India's logistics costs and interconnect various modes of transport through an integrated approach.

 

• It is a digital platform that brings together 16 ministries for infrastructure development.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• PM Gati Shakti represents a significant institutional innovation in Indian infrastructure planning, aiming to overcome the historical problem of disjointed, siloed infrastructure projects across different government departments.

 

NOTE

 

• 10, 20 and 25 ministries (Options 1, 3, 4) do not match the documented number of ministries integrated under PM Gati Shakti, which is specifically 16.

question: Mission Shakti, launched in 2022 under the Ministry of Women and Child Development, includes which two components?
solution_text:
The correct answer is Samabal (Safety and Security) and Samarthya (Empowerment).

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• Mission Shakti, launched in 2022, under the Ministry of Women and Child Development, aims to ensure the safety, security and empowerment of women through various interventions.

 

• It includes two components: Sambal (Safety and Security), which includes schemes like the One Stop Centre and Women Helpline; and Samarthya (Empowerment), which includes schemes like the PM Matru Vandana Yojana and Beti Bachao Beti Padhao.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• The Sakshi Niwas Yojana (formerly the Working Women Hostel Scheme, 1972, renamed in 2022) is an important initiative under the 'Samarthya' sub-component of Mission Shakti, providing safe, affordable housing and day-care facilities for working women.

 

NOTE

 

• 'Suraksha and Samridhi', 'Shakti and Saksham', and 'Suvidha and Swavalamban' (Options 1, 3, 4) are not the actual documented component names of Mission Shakti, which are specifically Samabal (Safety and Security) and Samarthya (Empowerment).

question: The MISHTI scheme, announced in the Union Budget 2023-24 under the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, has which full form?
option_1: Mangrove Initiative for Shoreline Habitats & Tangible Incomes
option_2: Marine Initiative for Sustainable Habitat & Trade Infrastructure
option_3: Mountain Integrated Scheme for Highland Terrain Improvement
option_4: Multi-sector Initiative for Sustainable Housing and Textile Industries
solution_text:
The correct answer is Mangrove Initiative for Shoreline Habitats & Tangible Incomes.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• MISHTI, announced in the Union Budget 2023-24, under the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, stands for Mangrove Initiative for Shoreline Habitats & Tangible Incomes.

 

• Its objective is to provide protection against natural disasters and increase livelihood opportunities by undertaking mangrove plantation in coastal and saline areas.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 1.

 

Additional Information

 

• MISHTI reflects a growing policy focus on nature-based solutions for coastal disaster resilience, recognising mangroves' dual role as both an ecological buffer against cyclones/storm surges and a source of local livelihoods.

 

NOTE

 

• Options 2, 3 and 4 all present fabricated full forms unrelated to MISHTI's actual documented meaning, which is specifically the Mangrove Initiative for Shoreline Habitats & Tangible Incomes.

question: The 'Namo Drone Didi' scheme, launched in 2023 under the Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, empowers which group by providing drones for agricultural activities?
solution_text:
The correct answer is Women-led Self Help Groups.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• 'Namo Drone Didi', launched in 2023, under the Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, aims to empower women-led Self Help Groups by providing drones for agricultural activities.

 

• 15,000 selected women Self-Help Groups are provided with training to fly and maintain drones, so that they can earn additional income by providing services such as spraying pesticides and fertilizers in farming.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• 'Namo Drone Didi' reflects a broader government push to integrate modern agricultural technology (drones) with women's economic empowerment through the existing Self-Help Group (SHG) network infrastructure.

 

NOTE

 

• Individual male farmers, agricultural universities, and private drone companies (Options 1, 3, 4) are not the target group of this scheme, which is specifically women-led Self Help Groups.
